messages:
micah: Hey all — addressed the comments from the earlier review on #PR 4821 (link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4821). PTAL when you have a sec. I split the larger change into two commits and added a short smoke script. CI is passing locally but flaky test `kv_allocator_test` still sporadically fails on linux/x86.
jen: On it. quick skim now. Thanks for splitting commits, makes this much easier.
arya: I can take a look after lunch. one question: did you change the public API surface or only internal config parsing?
micah: only internal parsing + a tiny opt-in flag `--enable-fast-prefix` (defaults to false). Not a breaking change. I updated the docs block and added a changelog line.
ben: glanced through the diffs. left two tiny nits: missing newline in the changelog entry and a whitespace in the test fixture. not blockers.
sam: PTAL in ~10m. can we squash the two commits or keep them split? for backporting it's easier if we keep them split (first is refactor, second is the behavioral change). :thinking_face:
micah: prefer keep split for history; if maintainers want squashed at merge time, fine. noted for backport.
jen: CI looks green on the linux/amd64 jobs except the flaky allocator test mentioned. can you add a retry in the test harness? we have a short retry helper in infra/test_utils.sh — `retry_flaky_test 3`.
micah: added `retry_flaky_test 3` in the latest commit and pushed. rerun CI.
ci-bot: Build 4821.5 started — linux/amd64, linux/arm64, integration, e2e. https://ci.redwood/builds/4821.5
jen: quick note: in the runtime config parser change, please add a small unit test for the empty-prefix edge case. I hit it in a local smoke run.
micah: added unit test `TestParseEmptyPrefix` and updated the README example. pushed to branch.
ci-bot: Build 4821.5 — linux/amd64 ✅, linux/arm64 ✅, integration ✅, e2e failed (timeout on e2e/load). rerunning e2e.
micah: e2e timeout looks unrelated (infra instability). rerun scheduled.
deploy-bot: Canary window available tomorrow 14:00-15:00 UTC. Mark if you want canary deploy.
sam: If CI is green by EOD, mark for canary tomorrow. I'd like one more quick perf smoke (10k tokens) before canary.
arya: I'll run the perf smoke against dedicated staging cluster after CI passes.
ben: LGTM modulo the two tiny nits I mentioned earlier. 
jen: LGTM (one approve).
arya: LGTM (second approve).
micah: thanks all — merging after final CI. leaving the branch un-squashed for history. tagging for canary window tomorrow. :rocket:
